title: Symbol Synchronizer
text: Correct symbol timing clock skew, 1 input, 2 outputs, {Timing error detector} sets Type of timing error detector Zero-Crossing; {Modulation type}, {Samples per symbol}, {Damping factor}, {Normalized loop bandwidth} sets the normalized bandwidth of loop filter, {Detector gain} sets the phase detector gain, {Normalized timing error output port} enables normalized timing error output port and {Simulate using} sets the type of simulation to run. Values come from the instance.

ports.name: Sym
ports.summary: Output signal symbols scalar | column vector

ports.name: Err
ports.summary: Estimated timing error scalar | column vector

params.name: Timing error detector
params.values: Type of timing error detector Zero-Crossing (decision-directed) (default) | Gardner (non-data-aided) | Early-Late (non-data-aided) | Mueller-Muller (decision-directed)

params.name: Samples per symbol
params.values: Samples per symbol 2 (default) | positive integer greater than 1

params.name: Damping factor
params.values: Damping factor of the loop filter 1 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Normalized loop bandwidth
params.values: Normalized bandwidth of loop filter 0.01 (default) | positive scalar less than 1

params.name: Normalized timing error output port
params.values: Enable normalized timing error output port on (default) | off

params.name: Simulate using
params.values: Type of simulation to run Code generation (default) | Interpreted execution
